# Bắt đầu một cuộc sống mới tại Hàn Quốc

Bạn yêu thích Hàn Quốc hoặc quan tâm đến văn hóa Hàn Quốc?
Bạn đang chuẩn bị du học Hàn Quốc?
Bạn đã sống tại Hàn Quốc hoặc đang đi du lịch ở Hàn Quốc?

Trên StickerBee, bạn có thể kết bạn với người Hàn Quốc và mọi người từ khắp nơi trên thế giới, tham gia các buổi gặp gỡ và cộng đồng, đồng thời trải nghiệm cuộc sống thường ngày chân thực tại Hàn Quốc.

**Từ khoảnh khắc bạn bắt đầu quan tâm đến Hàn Quốc, trước khi đặt chân đến đây, cho đến từng khoảnh khắc bạn sống và du lịch tại Hàn Quốc.**

## Gặp gỡ mọi người và cùng nhau trải nghiệm Hàn Quốc

Trao đổi ngôn ngữ, sở thích, ẩm thực, du lịch, tiệc tùng, lớp học trải nghiệm trong ngày và nhiều sự kiện khác.

Tham gia những buổi gặp gỡ phù hợp với sở thích của bạn hoặc tạo cộng đồng của riêng mình và kết nối với những người bạn mới.

## Khám phá Hàn Quốc chân thực qua góc nhìn của người bản địa

Mọi người thường đi đâu chơi? Ăn gì? Làm gì vào cuối tuần?

Khám phá nhà hàng, quán cà phê, địa điểm du lịch, lễ hội, thông tin về trường học và cuộc sống tại Hàn Quốc, cùng những câu chuyện đời thường được chia sẻ bởi những người đang sống tại đây.

Khám phá **cuộc sống và văn hóa Hàn Quốc chân thực mà bạn khó có thể tìm thấy chỉ bằng một vài lượt tìm kiếm.**

results.description:
Play local music or stream from a file/media server with LMP. 

Apple TV version included, with support for Emby, Navidrome, Plex, and Jellyfin.

▣ Import via iTunes or folder and play local tracks

LMP was designed from scratch with offline music in mind. You can store music on your device in two forms: iTunes music or audio file. The first would require syncing with iTunes on Windows or Finder on Mac. To import as audio files, simply transfer them to the LMP Music folder on your device via any means. If you choose the latter, you will be able to enjoy additional features, such as editing of metadata via the LMP browser assistant.

▣ Connect to a cloud server and stream music from the server

If you have insufficient storage on your device, you can also store your tracks on a server and stream from the server. File servers using SMB and WebDAV are supported. However, we recommend hosting a media server instead, via Plex, Emby, Navidrome or Subsonic due to faster import speeds. All tracks come together seamlessly, no matter how they are imported, providing a unified experience. You can enable the option in the settings to hide repeated tracks across servers.

▣ Manage playlists with ease

LMP has its own playlist system that allows you to not only add tracks from all sources, but also artists. All tracks belonging to the artist would automatically be added to the playlist everytime you open the app or rescan, even newly added ones. With flexible artist splitting, you will be able to ensure that tracks get allocated to the right artist.

When the AI playlist is enabled, LMP will also be able to generate a playlist for you based on your listening preferences. Usage data is only recorded if this feature is enabled, and all data recorded for this is stored locally, so you do not have to worry about data privacy.

▣ Supports CarPlay & Siri

With support for CarPlay, you can start playing a playlist or control what's playing from your car's CarPlay console. Alternatively, you can also tell Siri to start playing a track or all tracks belonging to a particular artist, or use it to control the playback state of the current track.

▣ Support LRC lyrics

LMP supports both embedded lyrics and .lrc files. Use the LRC or Enhanced LRC format, and the app will be able to autoscroll lyrics as the music plays. If you do not have time to add your own lyrics, you can specify the lyrics API to use, and the app will attempt to fetch lyrics of any track that is playing.

▣ Browser Assistant

Manage local files on the app using the LMP browser assistant, which you can open on your computer's browser. Import new files or move/delete existing files using the Folders tool, edit music metadata using the Metadata tool or even manage your playlists using the playlists tool.

Find something real to do this weekend.

QuestCircle is where you discover local experiences run by real people — a sunrise trek, a pottery afternoon, a street food walk through parts of the city you have never seen. Not a list of places. Things that actually happen, with someone showing you.

DISCOVER WHAT IS NEAR YOU
Open the app and see what is happening around you, sorted by how close it is. Pick a day, switch to the map to see everything at a glance, or filter by price, distance, or the kind of thing you are in the mood for — treks, food, art, music, wellness and more.

BOOK IN SECONDS
Found something? Book it and pay over UPI in a few taps. Your seat is confirmed straight away, and you get the host's number and the exact meeting point so you can sort out the details directly with them. Some quests are free — those you simply join.

EVERYONE ON THE QUEST, IN ONE CHAT
Every booking puts you in a group chat with the host and everyone else going. Ask what to bring, say you are running late, find each other at the gate. When it is over the thread stays open for a day so you can say thanks and swap photos.

MEET THE PEOPLE BEHIND IT
Every experience has a host — someone who knows the thing they are showing you. Read what previous guests said, see their rating, and subscribe to the ones you like so you hear about what they are running next.

HOST YOUR OWN
Know a route, a recipe, a skill, a corner of the city worth showing? Anyone can host. Set your price, set how many people can come, and QuestCircle handles the bookings and the payments. Track what you have earned in your creator studio.

BUILD A STREAK
Every quest you book earns XP. Level up, collect badges, keep a daily streak alive, and see where you land on your city's leaderboard. It is a small thing that makes going out feel worth it.

KEEP TRACK OF EVERYTHING
My Quests holds the ones you are going to, the ones you have hosted, the ones you saved for later, and everything from the hosts you subscribe to.

BUILT TO BE SAFE
Report or block anyone from their profile. A block is immediate and works both ways — you disappear from each other's view. Everything you post is yours, and you can delete your account from inside the app at any time.

WHAT YOU NEED
A phone number to sign in. Location access is optional — the app works without it, you just will not see what is nearest.

Welcome to Iceland.

A country that is expensive, tough to navigate, and full of tourist traps. The best places aren't on TripAdvisor. They're in the heads of people who actually live here. Icebreaker puts all of that in one app. From arrival to adventure.

Built by The Tourist Trapp, a software team with a mutual passion for creating outstanding experiences. Illustrated by Hugleikur Dagsson, Iceland's most famous and beloved cartoonist. Carefully curated by The Reykjavík Grapevine, the publication locals (as well as tourists) have used for over twenty years to find what's actually worth doing in Iceland. 

Now's your chance to actually experience Iceland.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Live map of everywhere good
Activities, restaurants, bars, cafés, swimming pools, museums, shops. All curated by people who actually live here, plotted on one clean map. Filter by tag. Save favourites.

What's happening?
Concerts, art, comedy, theatre, talks, kids-friendly events. See what, where and when!

Happy Hour radar
Pubs in Reykjavík compete on happy hour windows like sports. The map shows which bars are deal-on right now (with a live countdown until they close) and which ones open theirs in the next hour. No more paying full price by accident.

Cheap Eats radar
Where to get bang-for-the-buck meals? Built for tight wallets, not Michelin lists.

Currency calculator that follows you
Punch in any ISK amount and see it in your home currency. Tap a "How expensive is stuff?" card to fill the calculator instantly. Your chosen currency travels with you. 

Get around
One screen for airport transfers, scooters, taxis, car rentals, parking zones, road conditions, and strange local road signs that could save your life.

Pools, cinemas, museums, design shops
The classics, organised so you can find them on a tired day.

Weird Icelandic phrases
Daily sayings tourists won't have heard. "The raisin at the end of the hot dog." "To pee in your own shoe." Useful at parties, useless in conversation.

Honest local weather
Iceland weather doesn't behave like other weather. Ours adapts.

Grapevine pickup spots
Find the nearest physical copy of The Reykjavík Grapevine. You won't regret it.


Download your local Icelandic friend!

Have fun. Don't die.

Nature’s Playbook connects people to nature through shared outdoor experiences. We are building a VIDEO ATLAS of activities and locations that are recommended by nature enthusiasts like yourself to give you peace of mind and ample inspiration on your next outdoor adventure.


People who connect to nature protect nature. Understanding this, we foster the value of conservation, preservation, and giving back to our planet.


VIDEO FEED

Sometimes, photos aren’t enough. Videos provide a better idea of what to expect from a location or experience – you can recognize an area upon arrival, find a stellar lookout spot, as well as be more prepared for the terrain and necessities of an outing (e.g. How popular does this activity seem to be? Would my dog be allowed off leash?).


Plus, we believe in the old saying, “you’ll know it when you see it”, because an emotional connection forms when we find what we intuitively seek. Sometimes seeing picture after picture makes it tough to distinguish one hike or beach from another, but a video helps you feel inspired and motivated to experience something yourself. Our feed is video forward so that you can aspire to complete activities based on that emotional connection, and once you select an experience to pursue then you are given additional information to help you prepare for it.


SIMPLE SEARCH

On Nature’s Playbook, you search for experiences by location or activity. That’s it. We eliminate the distractions that cloud most social media platforms and only focus on outdoor locations and the activities that bring us there. Yes, we offer filters for you to find something more specific! But in general, our simple search engine creates a user-friendly experience to help you find your next outdoor adventure – whether that is skiing in the Alps, relaxing on a beach, stargazing in the Rockies, or strolling through a garden in your neck of the woods.


ONE APP – ANYTHING OUTDOORS!

Our app saves you from platform hopping. When planning a weekend or trip, we often want to experience the best an area has to offer, which is not usually limited to one kind of activity. Instead of going on an app for trails, then jumping to a surf app, and then on to a paddling app, etc., Nature’s Playbook is the one stop shop when searching for outdoor locations and experiences.

Everywhere You Are
Walk in a relaxing landscape or immerse yourself in the crowds of a chaotic city. You can use it in all four corners of the world, from a remote small town to downtown Manhattan. RandomWalking is your universal guide: with a database of millions of points of interest, we provide information and stories for an endless number of locations globally. Enjoy the freedom to walk with no constraints or fixed routes, knowing you won’t miss the wonders around you, wherever you are.

Personalize your tour

Social Dining: Taste the City Like a Local

Skip the tourist traps, overpriced menus, and crowded restaurants. With Social Dining, you can unlock the true flavors of your destination by pulling up a chair at a local’s dining table.

Whether you are craving a traditional homemade pasta dinner in Rome, a vibrant street-food style feast in Bangkok, or a cozy Sunday roast in London, Social Dining connects passionate local home cooks with travelers seeking authentic, immersive culinary experiences.

For Travelers: Eat, Share, and Discover
Food is the best way to understand a culture. Stop eating where the guidebooks tell you and start eating where the locals do—in their homes.

Authentic Flavors: Enjoy family recipes and regional specialties you won't find in commercial restaurants.

Cultural Connection: Share stories, learn about the city’s history from the people who live there, and make international friends over a home-cooked meal.

Dietary Friendly: Easily filter experiences to find hosts who cater to vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, or halal diets.

For Hosts: Share Your Table
Are you a passionate home cook? Turn your kitchen into a hub of cultural exchange and share your heritage with the world.

Total Flexibility: You decide the menu, the guest limit, and your availability. Host once a month or twice a week, it’s entirely up to you.

Global Networking: Bring the world to your living room. Meet fascinating travelers from across the globe without ever leaving your home.

Showcase Your Skills: From secret family recipes to modern fusion, provide a meal that guests will remember forever.

Key Features
Smart Search: Filter dining experiences by city, neighborhood, cuisine type, date, and price.

Verified Reviews: Book with confidence. Both hosts and guests are reviewed to ensure a safe, high-quality community.

Detailed Host Profiles: Get to know your cook before you arrive through photos, bios, and signature dish galleries.

Seamless Booking: Find the perfect meal and secure your spot at the table with just a few taps.

Download Social Dining today and discover the heart of the city through its food.
